info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Authorization Void API
info.description: The Authorization Void API allows businesses to cancel or void existing authorizations by specifying the unique authorization ID. This operation helps ensure that any unnecessary or erroneous authorizations can be effectively reversed, maintaining accurate financial records. Typical consumers of this API include payment processing systems, merchant applications, and financial reporting tools. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their payment workflows and improve transaction management.

post.description: This operation allows you to void an existing authorization identified by its unique code. By voiding an authorization, you can cancel its effect and prevent further processing or charges related to that authorization.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to void an existing authorization. Ensure that all necessary parameters are included to successfully process the void operation.
